standards_review.notes: 3 commits in range; 1 matches the documented EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence format (EPMCDME-8512: Fix WCAG 1.4.3 contrast on magical button by lowering hover brightness and updating gradient stops). 2 do not match the Tekton-enforced regex: 'Merge branch 'main' of https://gitbud.epam.com/epm-cdme/codemie-ui' (appears twice) — the merge strategy is squash-merge with rebasing, and intermediate merge-from-origin commits are not an accepted form in the documented regex.
.ai-run/guides/standards/code-quality.md is absent from the repository; no code-quality standard to adjudicate against.

Changed files (src/components/Button/Button.tsx, src/components/Button/__tests__/Button.test.tsx, tailwind.config.ts) are a WCAG contrast styling fix. Button.tsx uses no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no navigation from untrusted input, no cross-window messaging, no config or secret exposure. No security checklist items triggered.

blocking_findings.location: commit subject: "Merge branch 'main' of https://gitbud.epam.com/epm-cdme/codemie-ui" (2 occurrences in review range)
blocking_findings.violation: git-workflow.md documents the enforced regex ^((EPMCDME)-(?!0+)\d+:\s[A-Z][a-z]*.*|Generate release notes for version \d+\.\d+\.\d+|Revert "(EPMCDME)-(?!0+)\d+:\s[A-Z][a-z]*.*")$ for all commit subjects; both merge-from-origin subjects match none of the three accepted forms
blocking_findings.why_blocking: The guide states the regex is enforced by Tekton CI and the pipeline blocks on violations; non-conforming subjects in the review range would cause CI to reject the branch
blocking_findings.remedy: Remove the merge commits by rebasing the feature branch onto origin/main (git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main) instead of merging; the guide's Troubleshooting table prescribes this exact approach
